name: El helado Yukine
source:
This is Yukine, the magical girl of happiness and ice.

Accompanied by Haiiro, the magical girl of smoke and reality.

You will be with them for a happy dinner and Christmas gifts with snow falling in the frozen sky.

[From [url=https://galletadev.itch.io/yukine-ice-cream]itch.io[/url]]
